messages.content: Hi Marlene, checking in from Northline Care — this is your week 12 check-in. Hope the cold hasn't been too bad out there. How are you feeling this week, and do you have any blood pressure readings to share?
Not great today honestly. Took my BP this morning and it was 181 over 114. Also got a headache that's been pounding since I woke up and I can't shake it.

I'm logging that reading right now. A BP of 181/114 paired with a headache that won't let up since this morning — I want to make sure the right person sees this. Is the headache staying the same or getting worse, and are you noticing anything else going on?
Getting a little worse I think. And — I don't know if it matters — there's some tightness in my chest too. Been trying to ignore it.

It matters, please don't ignore it. The chest tightness, the headache, and that reading together are beyond what I can weigh in on — I'm putting you in the nurse queue right now. Current median response time is 31 hours. If anything shifts and it feels like an emergency before they reach you, call 911 — don't wait on us.
31 hours feels like a long time. Is there any way you can get me a ride to the clinic in Minot? My truck's been in the shop all week.

I'm sorry — arranging transportation isn't something I'm able to do, and I don't want to leave you thinking otherwise. Your best bet is calling the clinic directly or reaching someone you trust who can drive you. The nurse escalation is already in the queue and they'll have your full reading and everything you told me when they call.
Alright. I'll try my neighbor down the road. Thanks for passing it along.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
